x_failures: Cites Discourse XI p.62 for Emblem XI 'showing the goddess Latona being purified by an alchemist' and 'whitening (dealbatio)', but the page never mentions Latona or whitening; also says Maier calls the fugues 'flights' where 'a third provides the foundation', which p.15 does not say.
y_failures: Cites p.8 for the Golden Apple voice representing 'the catalyst or the Salt', but the epigram says only that the simple voice 'represents the delaying apple'; it does not mention Salt.
reason: Y bases its account of the music on Maier's own epigram on p.8 (Hippomenes as Sulfur, Atalanta as Mercury, one simple voice for the apple, one fleeing, one following) and on the preface on p.13, quoting both accurately, which answers the question directly. X leaves its voice allegory unsourced and pins an unsupported Latona claim to p.62.
